title: SSE event envelope
description: G5+G6 (D-G5-21): `event` is now the closed enum plan section 1.5 declares. Corrected in place -- this description previously named a different, seven-value vocabulary (read/diagnose/plan/consent/write/readback/receipt) that was never actually emitted by any route; the five values below are what `apps/api/routes.py`'s `session_events` endpoint emits.

id.description: Monotonic per-session event id, for client reconnect/Last-Event-ID.

event.description: Plan section 1.5's five SSE event names.

data.description: Every event's `data` carries session_id, trace_id, and the version tuple (plan section 1.5); the remaining fields are specific to the event name.

retry.description: Client reconnect delay in milliseconds, per the SSE spec.
